summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of POS Doctor web preview. All UI features, navigation flows, and language switching functionality working perfectly.
passed_tests: Initial page load with sidebar and phone frame
Language toggle EN/HU in sidebar (POS Doctor ↔ POS Doktor)
Language toggle EN/HU in phone navigation
Network scan screen loads with subnet input pre-filled (192.168.1)
Scan Network button starts scanning with progress bar animation
Device discovery shows all 3 mocked terminals (Ingenico iCT250, Verifone VX520, PAX A920)
Device list displays IP, manufacturer, model, serial, and status badges (OK/Warning/Fault)
Filter chips work (All, Online, Warning, Fault)
Device detail screen navigation from device list
Device info card displays all terminal details correctly
Run Diagnostics button navigates to diagnostics screen
Diagnostics screen shows overall health score of 75% (Warning status)
Health breakdown shows 7 OK, 2 Warning, 1 Fault categories
All 10 diagnostic category cards displayed (Battery, NFC, Card Reader, EMV, Contactless, WiFi, Mobile Network, Device Info, Memory & Storage, System Uptime)
Collapsible cards toggle open/closed correctly
Cards with fault/warning status open by default
Raw Data toggle works in diagnostic cards
Re-run Diagnostics button present in bottom action bar
Export Report button present in bottom action bar
View History button navigates to history screen
History screen shows 3 past diagnostic sessions with dates and scores
Build APK screen accessible from sidebar
Build APK screen shows 4 installation steps with code blocks
Technical Stack section displays 6 technology details
Back button navigation works correctly (diagnostics → device → scan)
Sidebar navigation works for all screens (Scan, Diagnostics, History, Build APK)
All UI elements have proper spacing, colors, and contrast
Phone frame design is polished and professional
